Nothing in the shown diff ensures `embeddable_hosts.category_id` is updated/validated when a Category is deleted. Downstream code uses this value (e.g. `TopicEmbed.import` passes `category: eh.try(:category_id)` and the admin UI renders `host.category` / `category-badge host.category` after hydrating from `category_id`), so dangling ids could lead to missing categories in UI or unexpected behavior on import. However, the diff does not show how category deletion is handled elsewhere (it may be prevented or cleaned up globally), so the failure mode is not strictly verifiable from this diff alone.
